items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: we come back to the mall, you see? Played for this Anthony, Balala, you see? Anthony Balala.

ctx.x: Babe call her, you know? Uh-huh.

That's nice. It's a nice name. Yeah. So, well, so I'll tell you, we've been fooling with Speck about, I've been fooling with Speck about 30 years almost. Uh-huh. See, so, uh, well, after we played for Speck all during the war, well, Benny's begin to drop off, you know? So, well, he quit giving dancing and he rented out, rented place out. So we start playing at the tip top. Yeah, he played the tip top. Played there. Played there a long time. Then I left, after we left from the tip top, we went, we go back, we go,…
